summary: vmware.vmware_rest deprecates content_library_item_info (removed in 5.0.0) and all lookup plugins in favor of vmware.vmware.moid_from_path.
questions: What replaces the vmware_rest lookup plugins?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest lookups deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
- `content_library_item_info` is deprecated and removed in vmware.vmware_rest 5.0.0.
- All lookup plugins are deprecated in favor of **`vmware.vmware.moid_from_path`**.
